sefinTools.label: Open source web tools
sefinTools.intro: Sefin Tools is a collection of simple, practical, open source web tools. Each project will have its own source code repository. Pull requests and other contributions are welcome!
sefinTools.bannerAlt: Sefin Tools - useful open source tools
sefinTools.contact: Have an idea for a new tool or found a bug? Email
sefinTools.cardDescription: Simple, open source web tools. I am currently focusing mainly on tools in Polish, but I also plan to create tools in English in the future.
sefinTools.homeDescription: A collection of simple, open source web tools for working with code, data, domains, files and text. Each tool is developed as a separate project.

blocklistGenerator.desc: Generate your own DNS blocklist for your server. Configure filters to match your preferences and start blocking exactly what you want.

meshcorePolska.desc: A Polish community building an independent LoRa mesh radio network - no internet or cellular coverage required. Documentation, antennas, configuration, a map and a Discord server.

sniffcat.desc: Analyze and report malicious IP addresses. Check reputation and download blocklists for firewalls. No tracking, no hidden costs.

cloudflareWaf.desc: Cloudflare WAF rules ready for production use and a script for automatic updates. Block bots, scrapers and malicious requests. Integration with SniffCat and AbuseIPDB.

sefinekDnsBlocklists.desc: DNS blocklists for Pi-hole, AdGuard, Dnsmasq, Unbound and more. Multiple formats, allowlists to reduce incorrect blocking and updates every 3 hours. Over 45 million requests served in a year.

maliciousIpAddresses.desc: A list of IP addresses linked to botnets, cyberattacks and artificial traffic. Intended only for traffic classification - not for blocking.

trustedIpsWhitelist.desc: A list of IP addresses used by trusted crawlers and services: Googlebot, Bingbot, Cloudflare, Stripe, UptimeRobot and more.

tempEmailDomains.desc: A list of domains used by temporary/disposable email inboxes. Useful for filtering signups, blocking spam, and validating addresses.

sefinekApi.desc: A free REST API for developers. Random images, data, and utilities. Most endpoints require no authorization.

esp32Monitoring.desc: Live environmental readings from the West Pomeranian Voivodeship in Poland. Temperature, humidity, pressure and light intensity measured by sensors connected to an ESP32-S3 board.
esp32Monitoring.name: ESP32 environmental monitoring

vstarcamEye4Viewer.desc: A local viewer for recordings stored on SD cards in Vstarcam / Eye4 cameras. Browse, filter and play back recordings without the cloud or a mobile app.

malkontenci.desc: A humorous parody of a psychology clinic. A test with 20 questions that places you in one of five categories of complainers - pure satire.

genshinStellaMod.desc: Better graphics and the ability to exceed the 60 FPS cap in Genshin Impact. Play more smoothly and enjoy improved visuals. A large community and a 4.8/5 rating on Trustpilot.
